description:
Automo helps you get work done across your business from one workspace. Create content, designs, videos and documents; research information across your files, brand assets and knowledge base; manage customers, projects and support; and work through mail, meetings, calendar and tasks.

Instead of switching between tools, you can tell Automo what you want to accomplish and it carries the work out in your workspace. It's designed for everyday tasks across sales, marketing, operations and business administration — whether you're creating something, finding information or organising work.

Everything it makes is a real Automo project. Open it in the editor, hand it to a colleague, keep going.

Your workspace admin decides what it can reach. Permissions are set per workspace and apply to everyone already connected, so a permission can be withdrawn without anyone reconnecting. Anything that touches personal mail, customer records or confidential folders starts switched off, and every tool call is logged.
